Device Description: The Axium m Detachable Coil System consists of a platinum coil Secured
to a composite delivery wire and is compatible with a 2-marker band
micro catheter and a mechanical detachment system. The
Axium" Detachable Coil System consists of three (3) components:
I- Implantable Coil
2 -Implant Delivery Pusher
3 - Instant Detacher. The Instant Detacher is packaged and sold
separately.
AxiumT' coil configurations include bare platinum, POLA enlaced
platinum and Nylon enlaced platinum coils. Bare configuration coils
are non-fiber-en laced, whereas POLA and Nylon are enlaced with
PGLA and Nylon fibers respectively.
This submission expands the size offerings of the AxiumTmD etachable
Coil System by adding one (1) new model number to the Axium bare
product portfolio with a new diameter and coil length combination (SKU
QC- 1.5-I- Helix). Currently cleared sizes for Axium' bare under
K08 1465 already include a coil diameter of 1.5mm and a coil length of
1cm; however, not in combination.

Intended Use: The AxiumM Detachable Coil System is indicated for the endlovascular
embolization of intracranial aneurysms and other neurovascular
abnormalities, such as arteriovenous malformations and arteriovenous
fistulae. The Axiumm Detachable Coils are also indicated for arterial
and venous embolizations in the peripheral vasculature.

Conclusion: The new AxiumTM Detachable Coil System size offering (QC-1.5-l-
